ruling.recommended_action: Refund $2.44 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexcused off-route kilometre; no account flag (driver has no prior upheld route dispute).

segment_findings.reason: Before 21:47:35 the rider agreed only to a stop at the place the driver named — 'the petrol station just ahead … for one minute' [F7][F8], a complete and timestamped exchange [F9]. The place the rider agreed to was not a specific named location and no stop was measured, so RD-3(a) gives no exemption. Under RD-5 the rider's prior consent covers the unnamed? no — covers only the corridor to a station 'just ahead'; the segment ran 1.76 km where the optimal route is 0.03 km and reached 979 m off the optimal route with no stop, an excursion beyond what was named and agreed. That unexcused portion is a route deviation under RD-1/RD-2; I count 1.00 km of the 1.73 km extra as unexcused and exempt the rest as within the agreed 'just ahead' stop.

what_would_change: F3: if the judge finds the rider agreed to this route or named this stop beforehand, it is exempt; if not, $2.44 is refunded; if the record cannot settle it, a person decides.
Had the driver carried a prior upheld route dispute in the last 90 days, RD-6 would add an account flag.
